messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1272] Error: dfs.mkdir(dfs.tempdir) is not TRUE
parts:
Hi,
rmr needs to create temporary files somewhere in HDFS and the default value may not be writable in your specific setting. You can change this directory calling rmr.options(dfs.tempdir = <some appropriate path here>)


Antonio
